_note: `target` is where the file renders. Without it (as in every other example) jobs go to your own ComfyUI: "local". With ComfyUI on this computer the models are downloaded into it on the first run (zimage is about 20 GB; --no-download turns that off). Change it to "runpod" to rent a GPU for this file instead - useful without an NVIDIA card; needs RUNPOD_API_KEY in .env. To make RunPod your default for every file, put JENA_TARGET=runpod in .env. A command-line --local or --runpod always wins.
